title: Unbelievably busy bicycle crossing in Amsterdam
summary: Nine minutes of unedited footage of a very busy bicycle and car crossing at Korte Prinsengracht and Haarlemmerstraat in Amsterdam. Cyclists, pedestrians and cars flow through without traffic lights.
why: Cited in urbanism and self-driving threads as a vivid example of dense mixed traffic working through infrastructure and culture.

quote.text: Watching that video sooths my mind and warms my heart
